name: Omadoku
author: Bhavesh Sooka
description: Sudoku in the Omarchy bar: a keyboard-driven board, pencil marks, and a game that survives a shell restart.

barWidget.description: A sudoku board in a bar popup. Left click opens it, right click starts a new game, middle click pauses.

schema.label: Difficulty
schema.description: Difficulty used for new games. Fewer clues, not harder logic — see the README.

schema.label: Show the timer in the bar
schema.description: Put the elapsed time next to the bar icon while a game is running. Vertical bars stay icon-only.

schema.label: Cell size (pixels)
schema.description: Board cell size. The popup is nine cells wide plus padding, and is capped to fit the screen.

schema.label: Highlight row, column and box
schema.description: Shade the cells the selected cell can see.

schema.label: Highlight matching digits
schema.description: Shade every cell holding the same digit as the selected one.

schema.label: Mark conflicts
schema.description: Colour a digit that repeats in its row, column or box. Turn off for a stricter game.

schema.label: Tidy pencil marks
schema.description: Placing a digit erases that pencil mark from every cell it can see.

schema.label: Pause when the popup closes
schema.description: Stop the clock whenever the board is not on screen.
